cells.gaps: Commencement is not stated, so the law is not shown in force. No regulations, application or event in the last twelve months have been found. The authority is named in the law (Article 19) and, per a 2024 source, not yet constituted.
cells.note: The law was enacted on 29 June 2021 (the 2014 text is the earlier, passed stage), which is stage 3; stage 4 needs the law in force and a dated decision under it, and neither is held. The authority is only provided, which would cap stage 4 or 5 but does not bind at stage 3.
